summary: A large production nursery with a visitor face — greenhouses, bonsai and cactus sections, and plants you can actually buy and carry home.
description:
Ekta Nursery is the campus attraction with a supply chain: a working nursery raising lakhs of plants for the SoU landscape, opened up with visitor walkways through greenhouses, bonsai and cactus corners, themed display beds and a 'plants for sale' section that turns tourists into people carrying saplings onto trains. A bamboo-craft and souvenir angle rounds it out.

It is free-entry or near it, unhurried, and quietly the most useful stop for garden-minded visitors. Kids get greenhouse novelty; everyone else gets the only souvenir on campus that keeps growing.
highlights: Working nursery behind the SoU landscaping

modes.road: On the campus circuit near the jetty zone

fees.note: Free or token entry; purchases à la carte

seasonality.notes: Season-proof; stock varies by planting cycle.

experience.photography_notes: Greenhouse rows make tidy leading-line frames.

amenities.guides: Nursery staff answer plant questions happily

emergency.nearest_hospital: Ekta Nagar facilities; Rajpipla civil hospital (~25 km)

tips: Buy plants at the end of your trip, not the start
Cactus and bonsai sections are the photogenic corners
